w:r.w:t: Responsible for managing and operating the system. The Admin manages user accounts, assigns user roles, manages medicine and laboratory test catalogs, configures medical thresholds and system settings, monitors system activities, and views system statistics to ensure the system operates correctly, securely, and consistently.

Interacts with the system to access and monitor personal health information. This includes viewing medical history, laboratory test results, diagnoses, doctor-provided risk assessments, electronic prescriptions, and receiving notifications for ongoing care and treatment.

Interacts with the system to manage patient care and clinical workflows. Key responsibilities include viewing patient medical histories, recording and updating diagnoses, ordering laboratory tests, reviewing test results, conducting risk assessments, issuing electronic prescriptions, and updating ongoing care and treatment plans.

The AI is an automated component responsible for organizing and presenting patient health data in a structured and accessible manner to support monitoring by medical staff. Key responsibilities include displaying patient medical records and laboratory test results, presenting vital sign data for easy tracking, showing diabetes risk indicators, providing diagnosis support reports generated by physicians, notifying medical staff of flagged health data, sending automated reminders to patients regarding appointments and medications, and responding to health-related queries through an interactive Chat Bot interface.
